assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced proximity to a ubiquitin ligase turns a small molecule into a general, catalytic chemical tool for removing any chosen protein. The cereblon discovery gave a molecular explanation for thalidomide, a clear chemical mechanism under a drug action that was long a mystery. Originality is high and the biomedical reach is large.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the PROTAC concept; Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which underpins molecular glue degraders. Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim and Ito also made important contributions, so a three-person limit forces hard choices and a split between the PROTAC and glue lines.
assessment.maturity: Independently reproduced by many groups, with clinical degraders in trials and imids in routine use. Timely and robust, though approved PROTAC drugs are still lacking.
uncertainties: Whether the PROTAC and molecular glue lines should be recognised together or separately.
Allocation among Crews, Deshaies, Handa, Ciulli, Gray and Sakamoto is contested; I cannot verify the detailed priority record.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing converts one base to another by deaminase chemistry on DNA without a double-strand break. It is a precise chemical solution to genome editing and gives biologists a general tool. Of the two Liu-lab genome-editing entries, base editing is the one rooted most clearly in nucleoside chemistry and directed evolution.
assessment.attribution: David R. Liu is the clear intellectual leader. Komor (cytosine base editor) and Gaudelli (adenine base editor) did the key experimental work as trainees, and Nishida and Kondo have a parallel cytidine deaminase editor. The CRISPR prize already given in 2020 complicates the framing but does not decide the credit.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent adoption and first clinical results. Recognition now is plausible; long-term safety data (off-target and bystander editing) are still accumulating.
uncertainties: Whether the committee wants to recognise a trainee-level contribution alongside Liu.
Overlap with prime editing (B043) and the 2020 CRISPR prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles enabled delivery of siRNA and mRNA and made the COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and siRNA drugs possible. The chemistry of pH-dependent charge, lipid packing and endosomal escape is real and quantifiable, and the societal impact is immediate and enormous.
assessment.attribution: Credit is spread across the early liposomal and LNP formulation work (Cullis, Hope, Madden, MacLachlan), lipid design and screening (Anderson, Langer) and the later mRNA work. The credited list supports a fair three-person set, but whether the decisive step was formulation or lipid design is not settled.
assessment.maturity: Clinically validated at a global scale and independently confirmed many times. Recognition of mRNA science in Medicine (2023) leaves LNP chemistry as a natural next step.
uncertainties: Close proximity to the 2023 Medicine prize and possible argument that this is a Medicine topic.
Disputed attribution among formulation and lipid-design contributors; I cannot verify patent-versus-science priority.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase structure and mechanism address how nature breaks the N2 triple bond at a unique metal cofactor. This is a central question in bioinorganic chemistry with a large link to nitrogen fixation and food production. Structures of the FeMo-cofactor, including the central carbide, are decisive chemical results.
assessment.attribution: Rees led the structure of the MoFe protein and the cofactor; Einsle resolved the interstitial carbide at high resolution; Seefeldt and Dean contributed mechanistic and biochemical work. Ribbe also contributed. A fair three-person set is possible but debatable.
assessment.maturity: Structures are well confirmed, and cryo-EM now shows turnover states. The catalytic mechanism, i.e. the hydrogen and N2 binding steps, is still not fully settled, so recognition could be seen as early for the mechanism but not for the structure.
uncertainties: Unresolved molecular mechanism of N2 reduction.
The credit split between structural and biochemical contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs allow site-specific incorporation of unnatural amino acids into proteins in living cells. This is a general tool that gives biologists a chemically defined handle in proteins, with broad use in mechanistic enzymology and therapeutics.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the approach in E. coli and then in eukaryotes together with Wang; Chin extended it to multicellular organisms and to quadruple-codon and orthogonal ribosome systems. Mehl and Yokoyama also contributed. Fair, but any three-person set will leave out significant contributors.
assessment.maturity: Widely used and reproduced across laboratories for two decades. Some applications remain at the research stage, but the core method is mature.
uncertainties: Magnitude of impact beyond specialist laboratories.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Sequencing-by-synthesis with reversible terminator nucleotides is a chemical invention that transformed biology and medicine. Everyone who works on genome stability and mutagenesis relies on this technology daily.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman built the Solexa chemistry and the single-molecule-array approach, and Mayer contributed an early parallel-sequencing concept. Rothberg and Ju are credited for other platform lines (pyrosequencing and related), so credit is split between platforms.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature and independently confirmed; the question is whether the chemistry or the platform engineering is the core of the discovery.
uncertainties: Whether the committee views this as chemistry or as biotechnology and engineering.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Activity-based probes report enzyme function through covalent mechanism-based labelling rather than abundance. This is a chemical approach that turns enzyme activity into a measurable quantity in proteomes, and it has led to inhibitor and drug discovery.
assessment.attribution: Cravatt is the central figure for the proteome-wide framework; Bogyo and Overkleeft are strong in protease and glycosidase probes. Weerapana is credited mainly for cysteine reactivity profiling. The credit is workable.
assessment.maturity: Widely adopted with independent confirmation. Impact is substantial but more incremental across fields than a single decisive breakthrough.
uncertainties: Whether the impact justifies a prize relative to other chemical biology candidates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible m6A methylation of RNA with writers, erasers and readers is a chemical modification system with regulatory roles. It is conceptually important, but I would want to see the quantitative evidence clearly separated from artifacts.
assessment.attribution: He identified FTO as an m6A demethylase and the reader function; Jaffrey and Rechavi mapped m6A transcriptome-wide in parallel. Dominissini, Jia, Meyer and Yang also have strong claims, and the credit is crowded.
assessment.maturity: Very active field, but several mapping and stoichiometry results have been revised, and the antibody-based methods have known biases. I would regard the interpretation as not yet fully stable.
uncertainties: Quantification and independent reproduction of key mapping data and of FTO substrate specificity (m6A versus m6Am).
